caption:
A warrior battles a demon tiger.
Seedance 2.5 dreamed up this entire river duel.
prompt:
VIDEO PROMPT — 46 seconds | 16:9 | photorealistic dark fantasy in an ancient East Asian wilderness, anamorphic 35mm film look, shallow depth of field, cold blue-gray and moss-green grade, volumetric fog and drifting mist, soft diffused overcast light, wet skin and fur textures | camera low near water level, smooth tracking and slow push-ins, broken up by two hyper-fast flash-cut montages | pacing: violent cold open, slow menacing standoff with dialogue, explosive clash, slow ominous ending.

CHARACTERS:
- THE WARRIOR: East Asian man about 60, weathered, deeply lined tan skin, intense dark eyes, long soaking-wet black hair streaked with gray, tied in a loose topknot with long wet strands falling over his face, gray-and-black stubbly beard and mustache. Dark navy-blue hooded robe, brown woven leather lamellar shoulder guard and vest, dark baggy trousers, a ragged brown straw-and-fur cape on his back. Weapon: a long dark wooden staff with a knobbly carved head, a rope-wrapped grip and a band of carved runes near the middle that can glow gold.
- THE BEAST: a gigantic supernatural tiger, bigger than a horse, heavy and hunched like a bear, soaked dark brown-black fur with faint rust-orange stripes, glowing fiery red eyes, long ivory saber fangs, wrinkled snarling muzzle, water streaming from its fur.

LOCATION: an ancient mist-filled forest gorge: a wide shallow river over mossy stones, huge moss-covered boulders, gnarled ancient trees with twisting roots and hanging moss, a tall white waterfall at the back, thick drifting fog.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:02.5) — Flash-cut cold open: five very fast cuts, about half a second each. (a) Wide, low angle: the tiger crouches on top of a mossy boulder in the fog, fangs gleaming. (b) Low angle from below: it leaps off the rock toward the lens, body stretched in mid-air. (c) Blurred close shot: its dark furry mass slams down onto the warrior. (d) Close side view: the tiger presses down on him, one red eye glowing. (e) Front, at water level: the warrior pinned face-down in the river, gripping his staff horizontally in both hands, the tiger above him.

SHOT 2 (00:02.5-00:08.9) — Pinned under water. Front close-up at water level, slow push-in. The warrior lies face-down in the shallow river, face half underwater, air bubbles streaming from his mouth and nose, wet hair floating; behind him the tiger's huge dark paws with long curved claws press on his shoulders and back. He grips the staff across the bottom of the frame with both hands, knuckles straining. MUST SHOW (00:07.0-00:08.9): the band of carved runes in the middle of the staff ignites with bright molten-gold light, and a golden glow blooms in the water beneath his face.

SHOT 3 (00:08.9-00:11.2) — Eruption. A brief white flash, then a wide shot: the river explodes upward in a tall column of spray in front of the waterfall; the warrior bursts out of it and flies high through the air, staff in one hand, silhouetted against the falling water, while the tiger is thrown off to the right. He lands crouched in the shallows with a big splash.

SHOT 4 (00:11.2-00:14.8) — Standoff. Low angle just above the water, behind and left of the warrior: he rises in the left foreground in three-quarter back view, gripping the staff diagonally across his body, cape dripping; the camera tracks slowly sideways. In the misty mid-ground the tiger stalks through the river from left to right, circling him, head low.

SHOT 5 (00:14.8-00:18.0) — The beast speaks. Over-the-shoulder from behind the warrior's left side, his arm and staff at the left edge: the tiger turns to face him, steps forward through the water and stops, head high, glowing red eyes fixed on him, lips pulled back over its fangs; slow push-in.

SHOT 6 (00:18.0-00:22.3) — His answer. Extreme close-up of the warrior's face, almost locked-off, shallow focus, the waterfall blurred behind: water droplets on his wrinkled skin, wet gray-streaked strands across his forehead, the blue hood at his neck. He speaks calmly with quiet contempt.

SHOT 7 (00:22.3-00:25.9) — The charge, fast cuts about every half second. (a) Over-the-shoulder: the warrior levels his staff as the tiger launches at him. (b) The tiger flies at him, claws out. (c) Wide side view: the tiger crashes through the river in a huge wall of spray as the warrior spins aside. (d) Side tracking: the beast thunders past him through the water. (e) Close: he drives the staff tip into the tiger's flank. MUST SHOW: a burst of golden sparks and light at the point of impact. (f) Over-the-shoulder: he jabs the staff at the tiger's snarling face, forcing it back.

SHOT 8 (00:25.9-00:31.4) — Circling. Wide, low angle, slow lateral tracking: the warrior on the left wades step by step through the shallows, staff held low and ready, watching; the tiger on the right paces in a slow arc through the mist between mossy rocks, head low, never taking its eyes off him.

SHOT 9 (00:31.4-00:33.3) — The eyes. Extreme close-up from the front of the tiger's face, very slow push-in: glowing red eyes, wrinkled snarling muzzle, long ivory fangs, whiskers, water streaming off its chin.

SHOT 10 (00:33.3-00:35.1) — Ready. Wide, low angle: the warrior drops to one knee in the river on the left and raises the staff overhead in both hands; the tiger on the right lowers its head and creeps toward him, splashing.

SHOT 11 (00:35.1-00:37.7) — Second attack, hyper-fast flash cuts about every 0.2 seconds: the tiger lunges off a rock, flies overhead, lands in an explosion of spray, swings around with water whipping off it in a curved arc, and roars straight into the lens from a low angle, jaws wide.

SHOT 12 (00:37.7-00:46.1) — The final stare. Low angle from behind and beside the tiger, its massive striped shoulder and head filling the lower right of the frame as it snarls upward; the camera slowly tilts and cranes up to reveal the warrior standing small and still on top of a high moss-covered rock ledge, staff in hand, against the white misty sky and twisted branches (from 00:40.0). MUST SHOW (from 00:43.0): a waterfall starts to pour down from the ledge, a white curtain of water falling in front of the tiger, which roars up at him. Hold to the end.

SOUND: No music. Rushing river and the waterfall throughout, forest ambience, heavy breathing. Shot 1: deep snarl, heavy impact and splash. Shot 2: muffled underwater rumble, bubbling, a rising resonant hum as the runes glow. Shot 3: a thunderous water blast. Shot 5: the tiger speaks in a deep, rumbling, otherworldly voice: "Only a fool would challenge a god." Shot 6: the warrior, low and calm: "A god?" then, after a beat: "All I see is a beast trapped in a river." Shot 7: roar, crashing water, the whoosh of the staff, a sharp crack with the golden sparks. Shot 8: low growling, footsteps in water. Shot 9: a wet rumbling snarl. Shot 11: an earth-shaking roar. Shot 12: an echoing roar fading into the rising thunder of the waterfall.

NEGATIVE: cartoon, plastic skin, extra limbs, duplicated characters, gore, on-screen text, subtitles, logos, watermarks.
prompt_short: 46s 16:9 photoreal dark fantasy in a misty river gorge: a giant red-eyed tiger pins an old East Asian warrior underwater, his staff's runes blaze gold, he erupts free, they trade words and blows, ending with him on a high ledge as a waterfall pours. No music.
